verdict.rationale: Shopify POS includes an AI assistant (Sidekick), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to connect external MCP tool servers. POS UI extensions and Admin API access are developer building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
